# Third-party test dependencies

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `doctest.h` | [doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest) | 2.4.11 | MIT |

`doctest.h` is the unmodified single-header release from
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctest/doctest/v2.4.11/doctest/doctest.h>.
Do not edit it; to upgrade, replace the file and update the version here and in
`test/README.md`. Configuration macros live in `test/support/Glob2Test.h`, which is
the only header tests should include.
